ud5.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
ud5.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe Suppabuddho nāma kuṭṭhī manussadaliddo ahosi
ud5.3:1.5: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
ud5.3:2.1: addasā kho Suppabuddho kuṭṭhī taṃ mahājanakāyaṃ dūrato 'va sannipatitaṃ,
ud5.3:2.3: nissaṃsayaṃ kho ettha kiñci khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā bhājiyati.
ud5.3:2.4: yannūn' āhaṃ yena so mahājanakāyo ten' upa saṅkameyyaṃ .
ud5.3:2.5: appeva nām' ettha kiñci khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā labheyyan ti.
ud5.3:3.1: atha kho Suppabuddho kuṭṭhī yena so mahājanakāyo ten' upasaṅkami.
ud5.3:3.2: addasā kho Suppabuddho kuṭṭhī bhagavantaṃ mahatiyā parisāya parivutaṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ nisinnaṃ,
ud5.3:3.4: na khvettha kiñci khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā bhājiyati.
ud5.3:3.5: samaṇo ayaṃ Gotamo parisatiṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
ud5.3:3.6: yannūn' āham pi dhammaṃ suṇeyyan ti
ud5.3:4.1: atha kho bhagavā sabbāvantaṃ parisaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manas' ākāsi:
ud5.3:4.2: ko nu kho idha bhabbo dhammaṃ viññātun ti.
ud5.3:4.3: addasā kho bhagavā Suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinnaṃ,
ud5.3:4.5: ayaṃ kho idha bhabbo dhammaṃ viññātun ti.
ud5.3:4.6: Suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ ārabbha anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
ud5.3:4.7: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nikkhame ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
ud5.3:4.8: yadā bhagavā aññāsi Suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi
ud5.3:4.10: seyyath' āpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakālakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya, evam
ud5.3:4.11: eva Suppabuddhassa kuṭṭhissa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
ud5.3:4.12: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabban taṃ nirodhadhamman ti.
ud5.3:5.1: atha kho Suppabuddho kuṭṭhī diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane uṭṭhāy' āsanā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Suppabuddho kuṭṭhī bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud5.3:6.2: seyyath' āpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī-'ti, evam eva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito,
ud5.3:6.3: es' āhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
ud5.3:6.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti.
ud5.3:7.1: atha kho Suppabuddho kuṭṭhī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
ud5.3:7.2: atha kho Suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ gāvī taruṇavacchā adhipātetvā jīvitā voropesi.
ud5.3:8.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
ud5.3:8.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
ud5.3:8.3: yo so bhante Suppabuddho nāma kuṭṭhī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito, so kālaṅkato,
ud5.3:9.1: paṇḍito bhikkhave Suppabuddho kuṭṭhī paccapādi dhammass' ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi,
ud5.3:9.2: Suppabuddho bhikkhave kuṭṭhī tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano 'ti.
ud5.3:10.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud5.3:10.2: ko nu kho bhante hetu, ko paccayo, yena Suppabuddho kuṭṭhī manussadaliddo ahosi
ud5.3:11.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Suppabuddho kuṭṭhī imasmiṃ yeva Rājagahe seṭṭhiputto ahosi.
ud5.3:11.2: so uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto addasā Tagarasikhiṃ paccekabuddhaṃ nagaraṃ piṇḍāya pavisantaṃ,
ud5.3:11.6: so tassa kammassa vipākena bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni bahūni vassasatasahassāni niraye paccittha .
ud5.3:11.7: tass' eva kammassa vipākāvasesena imasmiṃ yeva Rājagahe manussadaliddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko.
ud5.3:11.8: so tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma saddhaṃ samādiyi, sīlaṃ samādiyi, sutaṃ samādiyi, cāgaṃ samādiyi, paññaṃ samādiyi.
ud5.3:11.9: so tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma saddhaṃ samādiyitvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā sutaṃ samādiyitvā cāgaṃ samādiyitvā paññaṃ samādiyitvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ.
ud5.3:11.10: so tattha aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena c' eva yasasā cā 'ti.
ud5.3:12.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
